title: Golden Crispy Egg Puff
description: Flaky, layered puff pastry filled with a spiced hard-boiled egg and caramelized onion masala. A classic bakery treat.

blocks.alt: Golden, flaky egg puffs on a baking tray

blocks.text: Walk into any South Indian bakery in the afternoon, and you'll be greeted by the warm, buttery aroma of freshly baked egg puffs. This recipe shortcuts the pastry with store-bought puff sheets, but the spiced onion filling is 100% home-style goodness.

items.text: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Heat oil in a pan, add sliced onions and sauté until caramelized and soft. Stir in ginger-garlic paste, chili powder, and garam masala; cook for 2 minutes and let cool.
Roll out the puff pastry sheet and cut it into four equal squares.
Place a spoonful of the caramelized onion masala in the center of each square, then place half a hard-boiled egg (cut side down) on top.
Fold the opposite corners of the pastry over the egg and press down firmly to seal.
Brush the tops with the beaten egg wash and bake for 20 minutes until golden brown and puffed.

blocks.text: Make sure your onion masala has cooled down before placing it on the pastry, otherwise the pastry butter will melt and won't puff up!
